sloka: अर्चिताः चैव हृष्टाः च भवता सर्वथा वयम् ।पद्भ्याम् अभिगमाच् चैव स्नेह सम्दर्शनेन च ॥२-५०-४१॥
transliteration: arcitāḥ caiva hṛṣṭāḥ ca bhavatā sarvathā vayam ।padbhyām abhigamāc caiva sneha samdarśanena ca ॥2-50-41॥

translations.english: "by your coming on foot and by this show of affection." And pressing him with his two well-rounded arms, he spoke these words:
